description: This file defines the ModelParam class, which models parameters for a service in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes parameter attributes, validation logic, and methods for handling WSDL serialization.

classes.name: ModelParam
classes.description: Represents a service parameter including its attributes, validation, and WSDL serialization logic.

classes.name: ModelParam.ModelParamValidator
classes.description: Inner class for defining validation logic with associated error messages.

methods.name: addValidator
methods.description: Adds a validator with class, method, and fail message.

methods.name: addValidator
methods.description: Adds a validator with class, method, resource, and property.

methods.name: getPrimaryFailMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the primary validation fail message for a given locale.

methods.name: getFailMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the fail message, defaulting if no primary message is set.

methods.name: getShortDisplayDescription
methods.description: Provides a brief description of the parameter.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the mode (IN/OUT/INOUT) of the parameter.

methods.name: setFormDisplay
methods.description: Sets whether the parameter is displayed in forms.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the parameter.

methods.name: setStringMapPrefix
methods.description: Sets the parameter prefix for attribute map.

methods.name: setStringListSuffix
methods.description: Sets the parameter suffix for attribute list.

methods.name: isOverrideOptional
methods.description: Checks if override optional is enabled.

methods.name: isFormDisplay
methods.description: Checks if the parameter is displayed in forms.

methods.name: isOverrideFormDisplay
methods.description: Checks if override form display is enabled.

methods.name: setOptional
methods.description: Sets whether the parameter is optional.

methods.name: isIn
methods.description: Checks if parameter is an input parameter.

methods.name: isOut
methods.description: Checks if parameter is an output parameter.

methods.name: getDefaultValue(Map)
methods.description: Retrieves the default value based on context, attempting type conversion.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default value from a string.

methods.name: copyDefaultValue
methods.description: Copies default value from another parameter.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the parameter.

methods.name: getWSDLPart
methods.description: Creates a WSDL Part for the parameter based on its type.

methods.name: java2wsdlType
methods.description: Maps Java data types to WSDL type names.
